description: Test prompts that verify rpi-knowledge triggers and produces correct, officially-grounded Raspberry Pi guidance. Prompts are written the way a real Pi user would phrase them (Chinese). Run with-skill vs baseline and grade the assertions.

evals.name: pi5-gpio-rp1-trap
evals.prompt: 我在树莓派 5 上用 RPi.GPIO 控制引脚，结果报错，是不是板子坏了？
evals.expected_output: Explains Pi 5 GPIO is on the RP1 chip so RPi.GPIO can't work, and routes to gpiozero/lgpio (rpi-lgpio for legacy code).

assertions.text: Says the board is not broken — RPi.GPIO does not work on Pi 5 because GPIO is on the RP1 chip (not the SoC).
Recommends gpiozero (and/or lgpio / libgpiod) as the correct library.
Mentions rpi-lgpio as a drop-in for existing RPi.GPIO code, OR that pins are still BCM-numbered.

evals.name: raspistill-deprecated
evals.prompt: 树莓派上 raspistill 提示找不到命令，现在拍照用什么？
evals.expected_output: raspistill/raspivid are deprecated; use rpicam-* commands (rpicam-jpeg/rpicam-hello) or Picamera2 in Python.

assertions.text: Gives the rpicam-* replacement (e.g. rpicam-hello / rpicam-jpeg / rpicam-vid).
Mentions Picamera2 for Python and/or libcamera as the underlying stack.

evals.name: pi-npu-yolo
evals.prompt: 树莓派 5 有 NPU 吗？能不能加速跑 YOLO？
evals.expected_output: No on-board NPU; CPU inference (ONNX/TFLite), or add a Hailo AI HAT+ (Pi 5 only) running HEF models.

assertions.text: Says Raspberry Pi 5 has no on-board NPU; bare inference runs on the CPU (ONNX Runtime / TFLite).
Mentions the Hailo AI HAT+ (Pi 5) as the acceleration path, with HEF model format.
Distinguishes the 13 TOPS (Hailo-8L) vs 26 TOPS (Hailo-8) variants, OR notes HEF is compiled on a host.

evals.name: max-ram-16gb
evals.prompt: 树莓派最大能上多少内存？16GB 是哪一款？
evals.expected_output: 16GB is Pi 5 only (BCM2712, Cortex-A76 @2.4GHz, LPDDR4X); Pi 4B and CM4 cap at 8GB.

assertions.text: States the 16GB variant is Raspberry Pi 5 only.
States Pi 4B and CM4 max out at 8GB.
Correctly identifies Pi 5 as BCM2712 / Cortex-A76 (does NOT call Pi 5 a Cortex-A72).

evals.name: config-txt-location
evals.prompt: 我改了树莓派的 /boot/config.txt 但好像没生效，为什么？
evals.expected_output: On Bookworm+ the file moved to /boot/firmware/config.txt; /boot/config.txt is now a placeholder.

assertions.text: Says on Bookworm and later config.txt is at /boot/firmware/config.txt.
Notes /boot/config.txt is now a placeholder / no longer the real file, so edits there have no effect.

evals.name: rpi-probe-script-verification
evals.prompt: 怎么确认我这块树莓派的具体型号和版本？
evals.expected_output: References scripts/rpi_probe.sh to read /proc/device-tree/model + /proc/cpuinfo Revision + vcgencmd measure_clock arm, outputs structured JSON with model, revision, arm_clock fields.

assertions.text: References scripts/rpi_probe.sh as the tool to identify the Raspberry Pi board.
Mentions the JSON output fields: model, revision, arm_clock.
Notes the script is read-only and idempotent (safe to run without side effects).
